paper_metadata.title: Benchmarking Quantum Models for Time-series Forecasting

experiments.description: Quantum neural network for one-step-ahead univariate forecasting on Apple stock and pasta sales data, using a rotation-gate encoding followed by Ising entangling layers.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Neural Network with Ising gates
algorithm.convergence_criteria: early stopping based on validation error; training repeated across k-folds

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Data encoding layer with rotation gates Rx, Ry, and Rz; followed by Ising layers.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Predict x_{t+1} from the last n observations of a univariate real-valued time series.

problem_instance.description: Univariate one-step-ahead forecasting on two real datasets: Apple adjusted close stock prices and aggregated daily pasta sales.

dataset_specification.apple: Historical daily adjusted close prices for AAPL from Yahoo Finance; min-max normalized to [0,1].
dataset_specification.pasta: 118 daily time series of sales for 4 pasta brands from Mancuso et al. (2021); quantities aggregated across brands into one univariate series; min-max normalized to [0,1].
dataset_specification.train_validation_test_split: 500 subsequent data points per fold; first 450 for training and last 50 for validation/testing; 3 folds for validation and 3 additional folds for testing

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Min-max normalization to [0,1]; temporal k-fold splitting; grid search hyperparameter optimization; repeated runs per configuration.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: MAE evaluation on forecasts; averaging over 10 repeated runs and 3 k-folds.

speedup_claims.caveats: No quantum speedup claim is made; the paper reports that the best classical models outperformed the best quantum models.

experiments.description: Quantum Deep Boltzmann Machine adapted for time-series forecasting, using simulated annealing to solve a QUBO derived from visible-hidden and hidden-hidden weights.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Deep Boltzmann Machine (simulated annealing / QUBO formulation)
algorithm.convergence_criteria: early stopping based on validation error; training repeated across k-folds

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Inputs populate the visible layer; diagonal QUBO terms are formed by multiplying inputs with columns of W_vh; off-diagonal terms are filled using W_hh; hidden layer nodes correspond to qubits.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize prediction error via hidden-layer state selection; QUBO generated from W_vh and W_hh.
